Name: Scattered Stardrops
Author: YGSnaffy
Description:
[size=5][b]Scattered Stardrops[/b][/size]
[i]Some of the valley's Stardrops have shattered and scattered. Find the fragments, and make them whole again.[/i]

Hit milestones across every playstyle to earn [b]Stardrop Fragments[/b]. Every [b]5 fragments[/b] combine into a real [b]Stardrop[/b]. There are [b]15 fragments[/b] to find, so that's [b]3 extra Stardrops[/b] on top of the game's 7.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]15 fragments, every playstyle.[/b] No single activity gives more than 3.[/*]
[*][b]Delivered by mail.[/b] Each fragment arrives the next morning in a letter, often from the villager who noticed what you did (Willy, Clint, Gus, Marnie, Gunther and others).[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla Stardrops.[/b] Craft 5 fragments into a normal Stardrop. The game handles the effect, so mods that change Stardrops keep working.[/*]
[*][b]Tracker menu.[/b] Press [b]K[/b] to see which fragments you've found, when you found them, and hints for the rest. Works with mouse and controller, at any UI zoom.[/*]
[*][b]Existing saves welcome.[/b] Milestones you've already met arrive in one combined letter (configurable).[/*]
[*][b]A secret fragment.[/b] Keep an eye on the valley's garbage cans...[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]The fragments[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Farming:[/b] ship 300 crops, harvest an iridium-quality crop, grow a giant crop[/*]
[*][b]Fishing:[/b] catch 30 fish species, catch a legendary fish[/*]
[*][b]Mining:[/b] reach mines floor 60, reach Skull Cavern floor 50[/*]
[*][b]Cooking:[/b] cook 15 recipes, cook 40 recipes[/*]
[*][b]Social:[/b] 6 hearts with 8 villagers, 10 hearts with any villager[/*]
[*][b]Animals:[/b] max friendship with a farm animal[/*]
[*][b]Collection:[/b] donate 40 museum items[/*]
[*][b]Exploration:[/b] find 50 Golden Walnuts[/*]
[*][b]Secret:[/b] ???[/*]
[/list]Targets are for Normal difficulty. Easy halves them; Hard multiplies them by 1.5.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Optional: install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings in-game.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
Edit [b]config.json[/b] or use Generic Mod Config Menu.
[list]
[*][b]Tracker key[/b] (default K)[/*]
[*][b]Difficulty:[/b] Easy, Normal, or Hard[/*]
[*][b]Hints:[/b] Vague, Exact (with progress), or None[/*]
[*][b]Auto-combine:[/b] turn every 5 fragments into a Stardrop automatically (default off)[/*]
[*][b]Existing saves:[/b] one combined letter, one letter per day, or don't award[/*]
[*][b]Garbage can chance:[/b] chance of the secret fragment per search (default 1%)[/*]
[*][b]Show award message:[/b] HUD message when a fragment is on its way (default on)[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Console commands[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]ss_list[/b]: show found and missing fragments with progress[/*]
[*][b]ss_give <id|all>[/b]: award a fragment (arrives in tomorrow's mail)[/*]
[*][b]ss_reset[/b]: clear your progress[/*]
[*][b]ss_check[/b]: run the milestone checks now[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Existing saves[/b][/size]
You don't need to redo goals you've already reached. The first time you load an existing save with the mod, every milestone you've already met is awarded in one combined letter, waiting in your mailbox that morning.
[list]
[*][b]Counted from your full history:[/b] crops shipped, fish species, legendary fish, deepest Mines and Skull Cavern floors, recipes cooked, friendships, museum donations, and Golden Walnuts.[/*]
[*][b]Counted from what you have now[/b] (the game keeps no record of these): an iridium-quality crop in your inventory, a giant crop on your farm, and a farm animal at max friendship. If you don't have one on that first load, it's awarded as soon as you do.[/*]
[*]The secret fragment always has to be found the normal way.[/*]
[/list]To get one letter per day instead, or to earn everything from scratch, change [b]Existing saves[/b] in the config before loading the save. The setting only applies the first time a save loads with the mod.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ with SMAPI 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Designed for multiplayer and split-screen: each player collects their own 15 fragments, and shared milestones (museum, walnuts) count for everyone. [b]Multiplayer hasn't been tested yet[/b], so please report any issues.[/*]
[*]Doesn't change vanilla Stardrops, so it should work with Better Stardrops, Stardew Valley Expanded, and similar mods.[/*]
[*]Tested with Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0.[/*]
[*]No Harmony patches.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The new Stardrop crafting recipe counts towards the "Craft Master" achievement and the crafting part of perfection. Craft a Stardrop from fragments once to complete it.[/*]
[*][b]Uninstalling:[/b] progress is stored in your save and is harmless if left behind. Fragments still in your inventory or chests become Error Items, which you can trash. Stardrops you already crafted or ate are kept.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size]
All text is in [b]i18n/default.json[/b]. Translations are welcome: copy it to [b]i18n/<language>.json[/b] and translate the values.
